name.local: 台杉投資管理顧問股份有限公司

funds.name: TaiAx Life Science Fund L.P. (with Axil Capital)

strategy.thesis: Taiwania Capital is a national-level, government-backed (National Development Fund, 40% stake) investment company that manages a family of sector-specific funds spanning semiconductors, AI/smart tech and biomedicine; its biotech/medtech fund line (including a Japan joint venture, TaiAx Life Science Fund) is one of its largest and most active practices, backing dozens of Taiwan and North America life-science startups.

summary.en: Government-backed (National Development Fund) national investment company managing sector funds across tech and biomedicine; its two biotech/medtech funds ('Buffalo' Funds II & III) had backed 26 healthcare startups with combined committed capital of NT$7.54bn as of 2023, and it co-launched a US$200M life-science JV fund with Tokyo's Axil Capital in 2024.
summary.local: 台杉投資由國發基金出資四成設立之國家級投資公司，除半導體、智慧科技等基金外，另管理水牛二號、三號生技基金，截至2023年已投資26家生技新創、規模達新台幣75.4億元，並於2024年與東京Axil Capital合資成立目標規模2億美元的TaiAx Life Science Fund。

name.local: 國泰創業投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Cathay Venture is the corporate VC arm of Cathay Financial Holdings (Taiwan's largest insurer/financial group); its investment mandate explicitly names 'biomedical and health' (生醫健康) as one of a handful of strategic sectors, and it has directly backed AI-medical-imaging and other health-tech startups, often to feed applications back into Cathay's insurance, health-check and elder-care businesses.

summary.en: Corporate VC of Cathay Financial Holdings; invests broadly across sectors but names 'biomedical and health' as an explicit strategic focus of its offshore-repatriated-capital fund, and has directly backed health-tech startups such as AI medical-imaging company AIM to feed Cathay's insurance and elder-care businesses.
summary.local: 國泰金控旗下企業創投，投資範圍廣泛，但其境外資金匯回專法基金明訂鎖定「生醫健康」等重點產業，並直接投資如AI醫療影像新創采風智匯（AIM）等健康醫療新創，應用於保險、健檢與長照場域。
